title: #283 – Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space
summary: Chris Mason is a professor of genomics, physiology, and biophysics at Cornell, doing research on the long-term effects of space on the human body. He is the author of The Next 500 Years: Engineering Life to Reach New Worlds.
